chunks: And for whoever avenges himself after he has been wronged, there is no way of blaming them.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on avenging oneself after being wronged in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to validate the right of the oppressed to seek retribution, emphasizing that divine forgiveness does not preclude justice. It underscores the concept of 'Qisas' as a balanced restoration of rights rather than mere vengeance, a principle deeply rooted in the actions of the Ahl al-Bayt. The phrase 'ma 'alayhim min sabiil' (no blame is upon them) highlights the removal of sin when retaliation is proportional and just.
